questions.explanation:
The electronic configuration of Cu is [Ar]3d. It contains one unpaired electron. Hence, CuF is coloured compound.

In all other compounds, Cu ion is present. It has electronic configuration of Cu is [Ar]3d. All electrons are paired.

Hence, they are colourless.
